review: Cinq Association West Meursault or Cinq Meursault for short is a mixed bag of an ID having both Poise and Rupture. Like other Cinq IDs, his kit mainly focuses on having high Speed. Before we go over his Skills, let’s first get his unique mechanic out of the way. His Passive, if active, allows him to gain Haste for every 3 Poise Potency for a max of 2. During Focused Encounter (fights where you manually target your skills), every time he hits something with a Skill, he inflicts a status called “Focused Attack - Meursault” which can only be triggered once per skill. This status can massively improve his numbers depending on the stack count, with each skill hit on the same target slot increasing the stack count by one for a maximum of 3. The benefits he gains from “Focused Attack - Meursault” stacks are as follows: - 1x Stack: Gain Clash Power +1 - 2x Stack: Gain Base Power +1 - 3x Stack: G
